mapper.select:
SELECT FROM chatbi.bid_biz_bidding
ORDER BY publish_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(IFNULL(publish_time, ''), '|', IFNULL(project_name, ''), '|', IFNULL(city, ''), '|', IFNULL(district, ''))) AS distinct_total FROM chatbi.bid_biz_bidding

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(publish_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date_key, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chatbi.bid_biz_bidding
GROUP BY date_key ORDER BY date_key DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT IFNULL(province, '') AS province, IFNULL(city, '') AS city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chatbi.bid_biz_bidding
GROUP BY province, city ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tenderer AS fullname, tenderer AS name, COUNT(*) AS caller_count, COUNT(DISTINCT province) AS province_count, MAX(province) AS province, MAX(city) AS city, COALESCE(SUM(bidding_budget), 0) AS total_budget, MAX(publish_time) AS latest_pub_time, MAX(industry) AS top_industry FROM chatbi.bid_biz_bidding WHERE tenderer = #{companyName} GROUP BY tenderer
